card.title: We Started Equal
card.instruction: Use shared beginnings to erase present rank, titles, and attempts to place distance between you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We started on the same biscuit-packing line. Pass the biscuits, Director.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please use my title at work. The new staff are here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. This is the director. We shared my lunch when he forgot his.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you tell them something more recent?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He's sharing today. Pass that tin, mate; I'll do the introductions.
